[bold #D75FFF]◆ EPIC sase-17y[/bold #D75FFF]
[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]Relocation-safe bead IDs and epic launches[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]A concurrently minted bead ID never renumbers a bead that is [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]already published, and `sase bead work` only acts on bead [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]relocations it can prove moved its own beads. When publication does[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]move a freshly created epic graph, the launch rolls back by the [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]moved IDs and retries automatically, so an approved epic launches [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]without a manual retry and without collateral damage to other [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]agents' beads.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim] Counts: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]4[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] phases[dim][/dim] · [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]3[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] waves[/dim]

[dim]  1 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Published bead creations keep their ID in duplicate-ID merges[/bold #D7AFFF] [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]core-winner[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]core-winner: in the linked sase-core repo, make the merge-base or [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]published upstream creation win a duplicate issue_created collision so [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]only the local, unpublished bead is ever relocated; replace the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]orientation-independence tests and update the docs.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  2 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Identity-verified relocation handling in bead work launches[/bold #D7AFFF]   [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]launch-guard[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]launch-guard: replace the prompt and env text rewrite in [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]launch_epic_bead_work with an identity-verified check. Foreign [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]relocations are ignored; a relocation of the launch's own graph rolls [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]back on the moved IDs and raises EpicGraphRelocatedError. Also fix the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]resume callback that drops relocations, guard the task path, and make [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]the text rewrite helper token-safe.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  3 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Automatic recovery for approved-plan epic launches[/bold #D7AFFF]            [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]plan-retry[dim] · [dim][/dim]after launch-guard[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]plan-retry: when a freshly created epic is relocated, remove it by its [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]moved ID, restore the plan's bead_id, publish the rollback, and retry [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]creation (at most 3 attempts); relink a resumed plan to its moved epic [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]and fail with an actionable resume command.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  4 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Core pin bump, git-backed regressions, and incident cleanup[/bold #D7AFFF]   [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]pin-regression[dim] · [dim][/dim]after core-winner, plan-retry[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]pin-regression: move sase-core-revision.txt past the core-winner commit,[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]add git-backed regressions where the local creation is older than the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]upstream one, and repoint the tool_handoff flag registry entry to [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]sase-17w if it still names sase-17v.[/#D7D7AF]
